title: How Itinerary of Türkiye Coordinates a Medical Visit Step by Step
seoTitle: How ITO Coordinates Medical Travel Step by Step
metaDescription: See how Itinerary of Türkiye coordinates medical travel in Türkiye with flat client fees, independent vetting, and strict non-clinical boundaries.
quickAnswer: Itinerary of Türkiye coordinates medical travel through a four-stage, client-paid process: scope and preference intake, independent provider shortlisting using public regulatory registries, on-the-ground logistics for consultation and check-up days, and transparent flat-fee billing separated from clinic invoices. We coordinate your visit. Your licensed medical team makes clinical decisions.
category: Medical Travel to Türkiye — Independent Advisory & Safety (The ITO Standard)

body.text: What happens during the initial enquiry and provider-vetting phase?

During the initial enquiry, the two founders of [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/about) review your travel dates, preferred city, language needs, and logistical priorities before researching licensed facilities independently. You never receive a pre-packaged sales pitch, and no clinic pays us a referral commission to appear on your shortlist.

Knowing how ITO coordinates medical travel starts with understanding what we check before you ever speak to a clinic. International authorities including the [UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/turkey/health) warn travelers that private intermediaries often hold a financial interest in booking specific treatments. Because Itinerary of Türkiye is paid strictly by clients, our shortlisting process focuses on verifiable public records rather than commission tiers:

items: Confirming facility authorization under the [Turkish Ministry of Health Hair Transplant Units Regulation](https://turkdermatoloji.org.tr/public/media/files/Y%C3%B6netmelik.pdf) and official provincial licensing records.

Checking physician credentials against international bodies such as the [International Society of Hair Restoration Surgery (ISHRS)](https://ishrs.org/black-market/) and the [British Association of Hair Restoration Surgery (BAHRS)](https://www.bahrs.co.uk/news/uk-and-turkish-medical-associations-unite-to-issue-minimum-guidelines-for-hair-transplant-surgery/).
Gathering itemized, written clinic proposals so you can compare inclusions side by side without WhatsApp sales pressure.
Flagging cooling-off periods, language coverage, and proximity between vetted facilities and recovery-friendly hotels.

body.text: How does ITO keep clinical decisions 100% with licensed physicians?

Itinerary of Türkiye enforces a strict operational separation between travel coordination and healthcare delivery. We coordinate your visit. Your licensed medical team makes clinical decisions. Our founders never diagnose conditions, estimate graft numbers, recommend surgical methods, prescribe medication, or evaluate clinical suitability on a clinic's behalf.

This boundary protects your safety and aligns with [UK NHS guidance on cosmetic surgery abroad](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/cosmetic-procedures/advice/cosmetic-surgery-abroad/), which advises patients to consult the actual operating physician rather than sales staff before committing. In practice, every clinical conversation happens directly between you and the licensed doctor you choose, while we handle scheduling, written follow-up prompts, and logistics.

What on-the-ground support is provided on consultation, surgery and check-up days?

On the ground in Istanbul or other Turkish cities, Itinerary of Türkiye manages airport arrivals, recovery-appropriate hotels, private door-to-door transfers, and realistic daily pacing around your appointments. We stay reachable throughout your trip so schedule shifts, interpreter timing, or late-evening logistical questions never fall solely on you.

Medical travel days rarely run on rigid tourist timetables. A thorough in-person consultation can run longer than expected, and post-procedure check-ups require calm, low-friction transport. The [CDC Yellow Book on Medical Tourism](https://www.cdc.gov/yellow-book/hcp/health-care-abroad/medical-tourism.html) notes that combining surgery with travel demands careful planning for rest, English-language medical records, and post-procedure follow-up. Our [medical tourism coordination service](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/services/medical-tourism) sequences your trip so light sightseeing happens before surgery—never after—and builds buffer time for your first clinic wash, pharmacy collection, and airport departure. You can see a typical schedule in our breakdown of [how many days you need in Istanbul for a hair transplant](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/how-many-days-istanbul-hair-transplant).
How is ITO's flat coordination fee structured separately from clinic bills?

Itinerary of Türkiye charges a single, agreed flat advisory fee paid directly by you before coordination begins. You pay your chosen clinic or hospital separately against their official itemized invoice. We accept zero kickbacks, referral percentages, or hidden markups from clinics, hotels, or transfer operators.

Traditional medical tourism brokers frequently advertise "free" coordination while embedding 15% to 30% referral commissions inside bundled clinic quotes. That model incentivizes steering patients toward high-volume providers rather than the best fit. Our flat-fee structure removes that conflict completely: our compensation stays identical whether you select a boutique doctor-led clinic, defer surgery after consultation, or adjust your hotel tier. Paid by our clients. Independent of provider commissions. For realistic clinic cost benchmarks, review our [2026 hair transplant cost and quality guide for Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/hair-transplant-turkey-2026-guide).

Ready to plan an independent medical visit to Türkiye? Contact our founders through our [medical tourism page](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/services/medical-tourism) with your preferred dates and city. For your privacy and security, please do not share passport or ID scans, medical records, clinical photos, or payment details in your first enquiry. We coordinate your visit. Your licensed medical team makes clinical decisions.

faq.q: Does Itinerary of Türkiye accept referral commissions from Turkish clinics?
faq.a: No. Itinerary of Türkiye is 100% client-paid through a flat coordination fee. We do not accept commissions, referral fees, or volume incentives from any clinic, doctor, hospital, or hotel.

faq.q: Can ITO recommend a specific hair transplant technique or graft count?
faq.a: No. We coordinate your visit. Your licensed medical team makes clinical decisions. Only an examining physician can evaluate donor density, recommend a method, or confirm candidacy.

faq.q: Do I pay my clinic bill through Itinerary of Türkiye?
faq.a: No. You settle all medical fees directly with your chosen clinic or hospital using their official itemized invoice. Our flat advisory fee is invoiced separately for travel and logistical coordination.

faq.q: What if I decide not to proceed after my in-person consultation?
faq.a: You remain free to decline surgery at any time. Because our fee is independent of clinic bookings, you face zero financial pressure from us to proceed with any procedure.

faq.q: Does ITO arrange travel insurance or emergency medical cover?
faq.a: We remind every client to secure appropriate travel and medical complication insurance before departure, as advised by the [UK FCDO](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/turkey/health), but you purchase policies directly from licensed insurers.

faq.q: How early should I contact Itinerary of Türkiye before a medical visit?
faq.a: Reaching out 8 to 12 weeks ahead allows comfortable time for independent clinic vetting, direct doctor consultations, flight selection, and booking quiet hotels near your clinic.
